# Tomoni AI

> Tomoni is an independent AI consultancy. We help businesses work out where AI genuinely makes them more efficient, and build it in where it does.

Tomoni AI is run by Tom Williams. Based in Abergele, North Wales. Works on site with businesses across North Wales (Conwy, Llandudno, Colwyn Bay, Rhyl, Bangor, Wrexham) and Chester and Cheshire, and remotely with businesses anywhere in the UK.

## What we do
- Business brain set-up: We spend an hour with you learning how the business works: who your customers are, what you sell, how you sound and the numbers you watch. We write it down as your business brain, set up in your own account, with five assistants that use it. From the first week, AI answers the way you would, and everything we build after starts from it.
- Improvements, built and proven: We build each improvement one at a time, so the first time your team see it, it already works. They are shown how it works, what it does not do, and who to call. It is built around your existing systems wherever possible, measured against the figure agreed before it starts, and every record it touches remains yours, with full access.
- Ongoing operation and support: The improvement becomes part of how the business runs, and stops needing your attention. We host and monitor it, resolve faults by the next working day, and continue to improve it as the business changes. Every Monday morning you receive a short report: last week’s numbers, one verdict and one thing to do. There is no lock-in: thirty days’ notice ends the arrangement, your data always stays with you, and after a year the system itself is yours to keep.
